findings.text: blocking: Include the detached worktree in the anchored server's write roots; production dispatch.py:3324-3339 supplies _fence_write_roots, whose fenced_write_roots skips declarations inside the worktree and never includes that worktree, while fence_argv adds it separately, so Edit/MultiEdit are disabled and read_anchored/edit_anchored refuse normal source paths; the test fixture at tests/test_anchored_edit_claude_arm.py:59 explicitly injects the missing root and masks this production failure.
